description: Patch releases of GitLab Runner are automerged once CI is green.
Minor and major releases need a human review - see docs/configuring-gitlab-runner.md for keeping GitLab Runner in sync with GitLab.

packageRules.description: GitLab Runner's image tags carry a `v` prefix (e.g. `v19.4.1`), while `gitlab_runner_version` only holds the version itself (e.g. `19.4.1`).
